simulation.noise_model: two independent Gaussian 20-trial-mean equivalents; no stored individual epochs
simulation.waveform_model: phase-locked transient ERP without sinusoidal carrier
simulation.baseline_centering: each half independently; analytic scale includes active variance from baseline centering
simulation.noise_scale_rule: analytic expected baseline-centered noise energy; never normalize a noise realization
simulation.seed_rule: explicit replica_seed_roots fit/check (fallback seed_root) + SHA256(case_id)[:8] little endian + domain 6001 + half index; modality spawn
simulation.preprocessing: raw halves independently baseline-centered; training first 200 samples define each whitener; training modality evidence weights applied to both halves

windows.null_rule: separate layer maxima of baseline matched-filter norms; empirical regularization, not p-values

solver.smoothing_note: Positive deltas change the objective and remove exact sparsity; no hard threshold applied.
solver.convergence_note: Stationarity and iterate-change tolerances for this smooth nonconvex objective; no global-optimality claim.
